notes.title: Anniversary Patch 1.5
notes.content:
[h3][/h3][previewyoutube="ZYcTxZ76T08;full"][/previewyoutube][h3][b]New Enemies[/b][/h3][p][b]Poproach
[/b]A huge, pot-bellied monster that attacks with whip-like arms. [/p][p]Swells up as it takes damage and explodes upon death.[/p][p][b]Paincaster
[/b]Ghostboy's first ranged opponent! Its projectiles can hit either the family member’s soul or its protection from afar.[/p][p][b]Woeminer
[/b]A peaceful goblin… apparently. He goes his own way and scatters cursed mines that eventually spawn relentless shadow creatures, which immediately start following your Buddy.[/p][h3]
[b]Updated Enemies[/b][/h3][p][b]Tank Skeeter
[/b]The tank skeeter has a shield that regenerates if you can't destroy the creature in time.[/p][p]This makes fighting him more unique and tactical.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Updated Towers[/b][/h3][p][b]Carnivorous Tower
[/b]We really liked this tower, but somehow it didn't feel like it was the final form, so we reworked it. It can now be placed anywhere on the map, offering a lot more strategic options. However, only three of them can be active at a time.[/p][h3]
[b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We fixed a visual bug with Dad’s animations.[/p][/*][*][p]We fixed a bug with the display of several entities’ health.[/p][/*][*][p]We fixed a bug with the effect of the ‘Calling Helpline’ help.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Improvements[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We redesigned the rooms in the shock phase.[/p][/*][*][p]We added range visuals to the freely placeable elements to make it clearer where they can be placed.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Damage Feedback Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We made the Buddies’ damage more visually clear.[/p][/*][*][p]We added new animations for projectile impacts.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Tutorials[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We improved the tutorial levels visually, adding cards that explain the basic mechanics more clearly.[/p][/*][*][p]We redesigned the tutorial distribution for the shock phase and added new information to the tool selection tutorial.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]UI[/b][/h3][list][*][p]We added tabs to the pause menu to improve the usability.[/p][/*][*][p]We enabled allrange visuals for the towers in build mode.[/p][/*][/list][h3][b]Maps[/b][/h3][p][b]Controlled Phase[/b][/p][p][b]Puzzle Master [/b]–  It was a bit too difficult for beginners, so we redesigned the layout of the level to make it easier to complete in Easy mode.[/p][p][b]Awareness Phase[/b][/p][p]We wanted to make the middle part of the game more dynamic, so we:[/p][list][*][p]Redesigned the waves on multiple levels,[/p][/*][*][p]Updated the layouts to add more variety,[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced new enemies here.[/p][/*][/list][p]The redesigned levels:[/p][list][*][p]In the Bunker[/p][/*][*][p]In the Maze[/p][/*][*][p]Under the Bed[/p][/*][*][p]Spiraling[/p][/*][*][p]Small Box[/p][/*][*][p]Legs[/p][/*][*][p]Inside the Circle[/p][/*][*][p]Inside the Eyes
[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Reworking Phase[/b][/p][p]We loved the final section, but some levels were a bit too long. We've tightened up the pace now, making it more fast-paced and enjoyable. We also added the new enemies to the waves.[/p][p]Searching the Train - This level was laggy in some cases, so we focused on improving this part of the game as well.[/p][p]

[/p]

notes.title: Mental Health Bundle
notes.content:
Get high quality games about mental health on a constant discount. What games should we add to the list?

Dive into the Mental Health Bundle, a collection of narrative-driven games that explore mental health with empathy, insight, and creativity. 

In Ghostboy, experience the emotional journey of a family dealing with grief and mental disorders. With stunning visuals and powerful storytelling, it offers deep insights into various psychological challenges.

In Robotherapy, you're a robot therapist in a dystopian society that killed all the humans, but is still not happy. Treat patients, meet weird robots and enter their minds. If killing all humans doesn't bring happiness, then what does?.

notes.title: Ghostboy LiveStream
notes.content: Enter the eerie world of Ghostboy, where grief takes center stage. Join a newbie player as she embarks on a journey filled with heartache and sorrow, accompanied by the calming presence of the game's developer. But what happens when a psychologist, who was also a part of the development team, joins in to experience the game for the first time? Follow along as our player navigates the haunting levels real time. Watch as the psychologist battles as we explore the intersections of grief, video game, and the human experience.
